_comment: Source of truth for the CAC web family. Canonical copy lives in the cacnorthamerica repo (lib/network.json); it is copied unchanged into cac-salvation-center and yyam. Edit it in ONE place, copy it everywhere, then run: node scripts/check-network.mjs <path to another copy>. Only facts already stated on the sites belong here; use null where a fact is not confirmed yet.
